title: A Conversation with Mel Birnkrant
content: Timothy J. Fitzmaurice created this video portrait of Mel Birnkrant and his unrivaled collection of vintage Mickey Mouse and other comic character toys. (Link to YouTube)In the interview by Timothy's wife, Kelly McMullen, Mel talks about how he got started toy collecting, how the toys "speak" to him, and how his owntoy-inventing careerfueled his life as a collector and connoisseur.Although Mel's private collection is not open for visitors,his extensive websiteoffers anybody a grand tour of his infinite universe of comic characters.-----Mel Birnkrant websiteViewa playlist of my YouTube videosshot at Mel's "Mouse Heaven"
